steps.content: Nightingale and the rest of the guards retreat outside, leaving only you, the patient, and the psychiatrist in the cell.
Before the hypnosis begins, Chameleon warns you over and over again.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: It's not too late to back out now. You know better than me how stubborn Victoria is. I'm afraid she won't listen to what you have to say. Whether you try to save her or not, the outcome might be the same.

options: How would I know if I don't try?
I don't want to just give up like this

choices.text: How would I know if I don't try?
I don't want to just give up like this

steps.content: Eternal slumber is what the FAC wants, not what I want.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Alright, I guess if she insists on not waking up, you can consider going into her dream as a chance to bid her farewell.
She sighs and takes out her pocket watch.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Please relax and close your eyes...
You wait in the long silent darkness as instructed. Finally, a red light flashes before your eyes.
Swish!!
Suddenly, a sharp object penetrates your chest, and the shackles elongate at the same time.
The splash of blood and dark shimmer of shackles shines on the pale girl, dyeing her scarlet.
But you don't feel any pain. What Victoria pierced was just the "Chief" in her dream.
You are now in what Victoria considers to be "reality", a projection of her subconscious mind.
So in her mind, she successfully killed me...
Victoria doesn't hear you muttering to yourself at all. As expected before the hypnosis, she is completely immersed in her own fabricated "reality."

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Yes, that's it... It's the shackles... Daddy's warmth...
She happily buries her face in the neck of the "Chief," her transparent face mask specked with blood.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief!!!
"Nightingale" breaks through the door and comes to "you."

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Hahaha! The Chief has gone to another world, but he has left traces of his love forever.
steps.female_content: Hahaha! The Chief has gone to another world, but she has left traces of her love forever.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You're crazy... notify all the MBCC departments! Strengthen the defenses and put a lockdown on information!
The rescue team obeys the command and springs into action. Nightingale tries to resuscitate the "Chief," who has already stopped breathing.
Victoria ignores the chaos in front of her, and walks out against the flow of the crowd, hugging the shackles on her body.
The wounds on her palm keep dripping blood, leaving a long trail of blood after her.
You watch her drip blood all the way back to the MBCC.
Victoria, you're bleeding.
Victoria doesn't hear you and continues to walk on, immersed in her own mind.
You try calling her again for a couple times, but still nothing happens. So you follow her bloody trail all the way back to the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Victoria! What happened to your hand? Why did you bleed so much?
Victoria encounters an imaginary "Ariel" in the hallway of the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: It's not just blood, it's an expression of the Chief's love for me. When I stabbed the icy crystal into Chief's chest, I felt the heat inside. It was exactly the same warmth as Daddy's.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: What... what did you just say?
Ariel's voice trembles.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: I stabbed my blood crystal into the Chief's chest. I will wait for him to come back from another world just like I've been waiting for Daddy... Hey, why are you crying?
steps.female_content: I stabbed my blood crystal into the Chief's chest. I will wait for her to come back from another world just like I've been waiting for Daddy... Hey, why are you crying?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: You idiot! The Chief won't come back!

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: You are wrong. You see, the Chief loves me as much as Daddy does...

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: But your father didn't come back either...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's all your fault!
For some reason, Ariel turns into Hella.
Neither Ariel nor Hella is actually here. The changes are not in the object of the conversation, but her state of mind.
As if to confirm your hypothesis, the scene becomes even more surreal. Hella grabs Victoria's collar in frustration.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What blessing and healing are all bull*! There's nothing to do with it! They're all playing you! They're not coming back!

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: That's not true, believe me...
Hella turns to leave, but suddenly transforms into Labyrinth.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: According to the Discepedia entry, death refers to the irreversible cessation of all biological functions that sustain a living organism.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: How can it be irreversible... the Chief must be...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Not coming back.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: They hate you because of your "love."

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Nonsense!! Cough cough...
She breathes angrily, but there is no one in front of her.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content:
Liars... you're all liars! They'll definitely be back... Definitely!
I'm going to find Sis Anne. Anne won't lie to me...
The surrounding scene bends to the wishes of the dreamer and transforms into SALVA Hospital. Nurse Anne is waiting for her in front of the ward.
Victoria, wake up! Those people are just figments of your imagination.
Your voice still fail to penetrate her stubborn psychological barrier.
The scene changes according to her wishes, and in the blink of an eye she has come to SALVA Hospital.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Sis Anne! "Death" just means going to another world far, far away, right?
Anne just smiles at her without answering.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Death doesn't mean leaving forever, right? The Chief, Daddy... they'll come back, won't they?
Anne, still smiling silently, disappears in front of Victoria in the blink of an eye.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Where did you go?
Victoria turns around to find Anne, but a woman in a white lab coat stops her.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Anne also left because of your "love."

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: You're the only one left. Is this what you wanted?
Iron disappears when she finishes the words, and the hospital immediately begins to disintegrate.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Doctor? Dr. Iron?!

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Anne! Where did you all go? Cough cough...
All the shrill shrieking makes Victoria cough up blood.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Chief, I'm bleeding... why haven't you come to help me...
She screams all over her dream world in disarray, but nobody responds.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Daddy, you'll be back, right? All of you, you wouldn't leave Victoria forever, would you? Answer me!
Victoria, can you hear me?
She stands there, dumbfounded, watching the familiar buildings collapse like building blocks around her.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Everyone is gone... they all left me... The Chief and Daddy, too...

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Why... why is this happening...
As she speaks, everything from SALVA to the MBCC dissolves into white mist in front of her.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: They just went somewhere far away, and I'm just left alone. Yet why does my chest feel so unbearably painful...
She curls up in pain and desperation. In the vast world of the subconscious, she looks particularly helpless.
But now is not the time for sympathy. If this entire world collapses, maybe she really will be trapped in eternal slumber like Chameleon said.
Victoria! Wake up!

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Is that... the Chief's voice?
She responds to your call for the first time!
Wake up, or you'll really be trapped in eternal slumber!

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Is it really you... Chief? I knew you would come back for me!
Victoria struggles to get up and tries to find you.
I didn't come back for you, and neither will anyone else be back.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Why?
Because of your misplaced "love".

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Misplaced...

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Did everyone leave me because of my misplaced "love"?
Victoria keeps repeating this conclusion in mental conflict.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: But...
She tries hard to control her emotions, but her shoulders tremble and her tears fall uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: But what is the right kind of "love"...?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: I don't know.

Like a child who has lost control, she weeps for a long time.
You silently wait for her to recover from all the emotions that has been pent up for years.

options: Do you still want me to come back?
Do you want to be abandoned again?

choices.text: Do you still want me to come back?
Do you want to be abandoned again?

steps.content: She nods determinedly, her eyes brimming with tears.
She shakes her head, her eyes brimming with tears.
Then promise me, before you express your love to someone, you must ask for their consent and consider their feelings, okay?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: That way you'll come back?
Everyone will come back.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Including Daddy?
That is the one question you cannot answer.

Do you trust me?
Trust that I'll teach you how to "love" in the right way.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Okay.
Then I'll count down to three, and you shall wake up. Remember our promise and forget all the bad memories.
Three...

steps.speaker: Young Victoria
steps.content: Daddy, what is death? The book says it's a very sad term.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Death... is traveling to a faraway place in another world, just like what Victoria's mother did.
Two...

steps.speaker: Young Victoria
steps.content: Will Mommy come back after she's done traveling?

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Yes, she definitely will. So child, do not grieve over death.
One...

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Ch... Chief...
When Victoria opens her eyes, she is back in her sterile cell.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: I seemed to have had a long, long dream.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: I just remember that you were also in my dream, Chief. I had a lot of questions to ask you, but I woke up before I could say anything.
If you have any questions, you can ask them now.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Really? Then... do you dislike Victoria, Chief?
Something that shows your good intentions, but does not hurt or trouble others. And as long as it's a gift from Victoria, I'm more than happy to accept.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Something that does not hurt or trouble Chief... Then I guess no medication feeding, no syringes, and no forcing Chief... Hmm...
She still look somewhat perplexed. Maybe she needs some more hints.
Flowers, cards, handmade crafts, like origami, are some good examples.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Oh, I get it!
She looks at you, brimming with hope.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: What about... this?
Blood crystals form in her palm, showing the shape of a rose.
